text: The last attempt's change was sound; it failed only because a nested-run test hit the disk guard on low real disk, fixed in 3947eb3 (tests set the minimum to 0). Keep its design. No design-review role exists yet, so the request the cadence queues every 10 landed jobs carries its whole content: what to review (the code-health table, the files most changed and most broken since the last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops) and what to produce (a short design note with proposed changes, as a design-only job).
